target.title: feat(cloud-workers): openclaw worker mode running the embedded loop on the box
target.body:
Part of #104294 (cloud workers, milestone 2, PR 9 — the composition PR). Builds on the four landed milestone-2 backend contracts: #104688 (worker role), #104809 (transcript commits), #105275 (live events), #105719 (inference proxy). Design: `docs/plan/cloud-workers.md` (openclaw worker mode).

## What Problem This Solves

The four backend RPCs exist on the gateway side, but nothing yet runs an agent session ON a worker box. This PR adds `openclaw worker` mode: the entry point + worker-side runtime that dials the gateway over the reverse tunnel, admits with the minted credential + handshake, and runs the embedded agent loop on the box — with its persistence, model, and streaming seams tethered to the gateway, and tools running locally. This is where a worker box becomes capable of running a real session driven from the gateway.

## Why This Change Was Made

- `openclaw worker` entry: restricted runtime (loadPlugins:"never", no channels, no gateway HTTP surfaces, throwaway mkdtemp 0700 state dir, in-memory empty auth storage — no local model auth profile read). Dials the tunnel-forwarded local socket, presents credential + handshake, attaches to its single assigned session. Fails closed on admission failure (with a bounded 120s admission deadline so a leased box can't burn forever on an unreachable gateway).
- Embedded runner rewired: session persistence -> transcript-commit RPC client (base-leaf CAS + runEpoch + seq, durable replay dedupe); model calls -> inference-proxy RPC client (provider/model reference strings only, streamed deltas + terminal, durable-replay resume); streaming -> live-event RPC client (monotonic seq, cumulative ACK, unacked-tail replay). Tools are the six coding tools (read/write/edit/apply_patch/exec/process), local-only, fail-closed availability check.
- Reconnect/resume: exact-frame transcript retry (ledger dedupe), cumulative live-ACK replay of the unacked tail, durable inference resume (single provider call, no double-bill). Owner-epoch supersession -> clean fenced exit. Oversized transcript messages fail closed producer-side.

## Deep-review fixes (a dedicated adversarial review found real concurrency/lifecycle bugs)

- **BLOCKER fixed:** stop() during an in-flight transcript commit spun forever (100% CPU hang on SIGINT/SIGTERM) because the terminal `stopped` state was indistinguishable from a transient interrupt and the commit retry loop treated it as retryable. Introduced a terminal WorkerConnectionStoppedError; retry loops now retry only transient interruptions and rethrow on any terminal state. Stop-in-flight and post-stop emit settle promptly.
- **Blast-radius fixed:** a gateway live-event window reset (a streaming-telemetry cursor reset) used to abort the entire run including a healthy in-flight inference turn. Now: satisfiable resyncs renumber the unacked tail from the gateway's expectedSeq (the gateway explicitly tolerates renumbered replay); an unrecoverable live-seam failure degrades to lossy preview streaming while inference/transcript continue. Live events are preview; they no longer kill the turn.
- **Dead-seam removed + contract documented:** the unused in-process resumeFromBase resync was removed (leaf-only rebasing is unsafe — an unseen transcript mutation means stale inference context). On stale-base-leaf the run fail-stops with an explicit lost-tail lifecycle error and no duplicate commit; relaunch-with-fresh-context is milestone-3 (placement) territory, now documented in docs/cli/worker.md.
- **Hardening:** the worker's session write path is now a real promise-chain mutex (was a pass-through relying on an unguarded serial-emission invariant); bounded admission deadline.

## User Impact

Opt-in only; dispatch/UI (target bar, placement) is milestone 3. This makes a worker box able to run a session end-to-end. No config/changelog/version-bump changes.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox: src/worker (runtime, RPC clients, launch), gateway worker-environments, CLI command policy, lint-suppressions — 744 tests green, including the deep-review regression tests (stop-during-commit, resync-below-cursor renumber, live-seam-failure-does-not-abort, stale-base-leaf fail-stop, epoch-flip mid-inference, reconnect-mid-stream single provider call).
- Dedicated adversarial correctness review verified the hard parts correct (CAS/seq/replay dedupe, live ACK math, inference resume/no-double-bill, epoch fencing under withLock, restriction invariants) and found the bugs above, all fixed.
- Clean build (rm -rf dist): public plugin-SDK declaration graph 5,077,853/5,100,000; no [INEFFECTIVE_DYNAMIC_IMPORT]. Type-aware lint, check:test-types, madge + import cycles zero, protocol:check, docs:map:check all green. Codex fresh autoreview clean.
